Name: JunimoB Butterfish
Author: JunimoB
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A collection of Butterfish themed items and additions inspired by the Butterfish in FlashShifter's Stardew Valley Expanded Mod!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and content patcher and unzip them both into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Run the game using SMAPI.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds 4 butterfish themed paintings, 4 butterfish themed decor pieces, 3 butterfish themed wallpaper options, and 2 butterfish themed flooring options. Much more to come soon in 2.0[/color][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A huge thank you to FlashShifter for creating the butterfish as part of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded Mod[/url] as well as a thank you to my community!



[b]The Junimo B Butterfish mod came to be in conjunction with the release of my butterfish plushie! [url=https://shop.junimob.com/products/junimob-butterfish-plushie-pre-order]More info here![/url][/b][/color][/size]
